blocks.html:
Pagadian is abuzz with excitement and celebration as Robinsons Malls brought a fresh wave of shopping, dining and amusement selections to the City. Robinsons Pagadian, the 56th mall of Robinsons Land, opened on April 3 to a record-breaking number of customers who wanted to be among the first to experience the mall’s topnotch line-up of national and local retail brands, first-in-the-city ultramodern cinemas, and innovative attractions and activities for the whole family.

Robinsons Pagadian is at the forefront of commercial life in the area, as it is strategically located in front of the City Hall and famous landmarks Plaza Luz and the Legislative Building. Its central location paves the way for more local entrepreneurs and businesses to capitalize on the city’s growing market and booming economy. The mall design is a sight to behold, as it pays homage to the region's rich cultural heritage, with colorful hues inspired by the iconic vinta and brightly lit interiors that evoke the shimmering sea.

Shopping will never be the same for Pagadianons as the new mall boasts of an array of first-in-the-city retail shops including Robinsons Department Store, Robinsons Appliances, Power Mac, Daiso, Levi's, Regatta, The Face Shop, Plains and Prints, National Bookstore, Toby’s Sports, and many more. Casual dining is elevated to a whole new level with the opening of the city’s first branches of KFC, Kenny Rogers, Gerry’s Grill, Shakey’s, Samgyupsaab, Dairy Queen, and Llaollao, together with the new branches of local favorites Ambrosia, Steamworks, Sikwate, and Kai Coffee.

Robinsons Pagadian also heralds a new era of family leisure and entertainment with the opening of the city’s first cinemas under Robinsons Movieworld which features two state-of-the-art theaters equipped with laser projection systems and Dolby Digital 7.1 Surround Sound. Family fun bonding time will surely be more memorable with the city’s first Kidzoona, World of Fun, and Tom's World amusement centers.
While shopping and dining, customers can also capture special IG-worthy moments with the mall’s vibrant interiors, the colorful Vinta display, or Pagadian’s beloved Bao-bao tricycle.
All these and more make Robinsons Pagadian not just the city’s newest lifestyle destination but also the best place for Pagadianons to experience malling like never before.

blocks.cap: The mall was formally opened by distinguished guests, including (from L-R) Faraday Go, Robinsons Land Executive Vice President & Business Unit General Manager; Robina Gokongwei-Pe, Chairman of Robinsons Retail Holdings Inc.; Hon. Sammy Co, Mayor of Pagadian City; Lance Gokongwei, President and CEO, JG Summit Holdings; Most Reverend Archbishop Martin Jumoad; Hon. Victor Yu, Governor of Zamboanga del Sur; Mybelle Aragon-GoBio, Robinsons Land President & CEO; Stanley Co, President & CEO of Robinsons Retail Holdings Inc.
